notes: Gravimetric (Hiden IGA) H2 uptake at -196 °C ('in a liquid nitrogen bath'), 0-20 bar, buoyancy-corrected (main p. 2). Sorbents are a ZrC-derived carbon (stated metal-free by TGA and XRF, main p. 3) and its KOH-activated carbons AC-600 to AC-900, plus Zr-CDC2 (1302 m2 g-1, 2.8 wt% at -196 °C and 20 bar, main p. 4 text). Surface areas by BET, P/Po 0.02-0.22 (main p. 2, Material characterization). Supplementary Table 1 (si1 p. 3) lists other groups' values for comparison only; the paper does not state that its own uptake values were published before. Not a review; record is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF. Minus signs restored from the page images where the text layer drops them.
